title: Triadic scale-dependent scalar-tensor gravity: hypotheses and a restricted FLRW compatibility construction
description: Original working manuscript with an accompanying technical addendum and symbolic checks. The curvature identification is treated as a solution ansatz for an independent scalar, not substituted into the action before variation. A reconstructed vacuum FLRW family demonstrates restricted compatibility with UA=0. It does not establish compatibility of the specified periodic potential, the 41.1-to-22 transition, local-gravity viability, or a predicted baryon abundance.
